**Disposition: conditional mechanism supported by an independent reconstruction and exhaustive finite checks; practical capability gain NOT_ACHIEVED.** This note separates the capital's theorem from the derived extension and from executable checks. The extension is a candidate change to the sampler's representation and resource bound, not a new output law or a verified practical speedup. Novelty and independent external review remain open.

## Pinned source and audited claim

The source card `N610-rank-absorbing-stratified-exact-local-stationary-sampling` is marked `source_derived_unreviewed`. In capital snapshot `work/astra-capital-scientific-power-20261015` at `25fc24509a59aabee340b36b588c9e59a144253d`, the theorem and model are in `updates/CP/package/stratified_noise_absorption_research_package_2026-10-10/stratified_noise_absorption_research_2026-10-10.md`, SHA-256 `72e51b3a71b5ed01f54a0c602f027f86889ef9495fcfbde51119214588b9bc0b`. Lines 11–69 state the finite-field model, joint local stationary sampler, category-query bound and local-observable scope; lines 78–119 give rank absorption and exactness; lines 121–160 give complexity and tail details. The exact extracted proof ranges are `frontier/proof_ranges/91d9466cb528f1d467aeb99e.txt` (source lines 11–69) and `frontier/proof_ranges/cec139a105635d2ebc036205.txt` (source lines 78–161). The associated open gate is `G-CP-N610`.

The theorem's contract is essential: one category per site-time is shared across all layers and memoized; conditional on `Haar`, each layer receives an independent uniform state; same-layer dependence is affine and strictly one time-step causal; nonlinear forcing at layer `ell` depends only on strictly lower layers; parent, coefficient, residual, forcing-description, forcing-evaluation, address and random-bit interfaces are acquired and charged. Exact category probabilities require an exact sampler (rational probabilities suffice with ideal random bits). This is not a physical-randomness claim, full-state sampler, generic nonlinear network result, or full-system mixing bound.

# Independent derivation before extension-proof review

Date: 2026-10-15. Auditor reconstructed the mechanism from the N610 source, before reading the new ring implementation or extension proof. Capital pin: `25fc24509a59aabee340b36b588c9e59a144253d`. Source note SHA-256: `72e51b3a71b5ed01f54a0c602f027f86889ef9495fcfbde51119214588b9bc0b`.

Let G be a supplied, explicitly represented finite abelian group. Replace each scalar coefficient by a supplied endomorphism A:G→G. At one original layer, a pending site-time z carries a homomorphism T_z:G→H, H=G^a, where a is the number of requested raw G-valued coordinates. Aggregate coincident dependencies by addition of homomorphisms; process them in descending time. On a gate, the parent contribution is T_z∘A, not a division or a preimage. Retain T_z(F_z(lower)) as an unevaluated forcing term.

Maintain V≤H generated by the images of the retained Haar homomorphisms. A pending dependency can be discarded precisely when im(T_z)⊆V. For a Haar event, add im(T_z) to V. No Haar values are exposed before all dependencies and lower forcing prerequisites are selected.

If U is independent and uniform on V and Z takes values in V, then U+Z is uniform on V, including jointly with any other variables independent of U. This statement fails when U and Z are correlated. Here descending-time substitution ensures every discarded same-layer ancestor precedes the revealed Haar events; conditional on the shared category field and lower-layer histories, those Haar coordinates are independent of the older same-layer process. Strict triangularity makes the entire lower-layer process independent of upper-layer Haar values conditional on the category field. These two facts supply the required independence. Category-only adaptive selection does not bias the unexposed Haar coordinates.

Each exposed Haar event has im(T_z) not contained in V and therefore strictly enlarges V. Every strict subgroup inclusion increases order by an integer factor at least two. The maximum chain length in G^a is a Ω(|G|), where Ω counts prime factors with multiplicity. Thus fresh categories at this layer are dominated by NB(a Ω(|G|),s). The algorithm needs no factorization to run: a log2|G| is a valid looser bound.

For cyclic G=Z/MZ, T_z is represented by a coefficient vector v_z∈(Z/MZ)^a. The image is the cyclic subgroup generated by v_z, so testing v_z∈V suffices
